checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-doctor.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" doctor --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao doctor [flags]' "$tmp/help"; for child in capabilities diff explain fix gc health ls robot-docs undo; do grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]+$child[[:space:]]" "$tmp/help"; done; mkdir -p "$tmp/repo/.doctor/runs/old"; printf '{"started_at":"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"}\n' >"$tmp/repo/.doctor/runs/old/report.json"; set +e; "$tmp/ao" doctor junk >"$tmp/junk.out" 2>"$tmp/junk.err"; junk=$?; set -e; test "$junk" -eq 1; (cd "$tmp/repo" && "$tmp/ao" doctor gc --before 2026-01-01 --yes >"$tmp/gc.real"); grep -qx 'pruned 1 run(s)' "$tmp/gc.real"; test ! -e "$tmp/repo/.doctor/runs/old"

aliases.reason: The doctor family declares no aliases.

tracker_selection.reason: Doctor inspects health and repair state but does not select the repository issue tracker.
